text: Grouped-query attention is a variant of multi-head attention in which several query heads share a single key-value head. Compared to full multi-head attention it reduces the size of the key-value cache by the grouping factor, and compared to multi-query attention it preserves most of the quality of the original model. Frontier models in 2026 commonly use group ratios of eight query heads per key-value head, which makes million-token context windows practical to serve.

Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by letting a small draft model propose several tokens which the large target model then verifies in a single forward pass. Accepted tokens are emitted immediately and the first rejected position is resampled from the target distribution, so the output distribution is provably identical to standard sampling while wall-clock latency drops substantially on memory-bound decode workloads.

Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants, algae, and certain bacteria convert light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose. In the light-dependent reactions, chlorophyll absorbs photons and uses the energy to split water molecules, releasing oxygen as a byproduct. The Calvin cycle then fixes atmospheric carbon dioxide into three-carbon sugars, which the organism uses for growth and respiration.
